question: Why does even an apparently unsupported imagined appearance not collapse?
premises: An imagined appearance may seem to have no support.
Yet it does not fall away into collapse.
This is because the universe rests in its own supporting power.
inference: All appearances, even imagined ones, are upheld by the self-supporting power of consciousness.
plain_english: Even what is imagined and seems without support does not fall away, because the universe rests in its own supporting power; reflect on it in this way.
